bio: Choose between tasting menus (including a vegetarian menu) and an à la carte at this restaurant, where the chef prepares creative dishes, including various types of offal on his Quinto Quarto menu. The à la carte offers an extensive choice, featuring an array of local specialities and excellent bread options. There’s also a superb wine selection with a focus on Asti and its surrounding area, as well as on the Langhe region....
